changes_from_v1: 2026-10-11 hardening (docs/audits/2026-10-11-blackswan/2-overfitting.md): 1.6 trial count = max(dsr_inputs.trials, provenance.trials.count + battery candidates, research-service ledger count for the kind) + others, trials ledger cross-check, V[SR] floor; 1.13 synthetic-view cap enforced by AlphaKeel; 1.14 review-credential only, min_closed 5 -> 20, unregistered runs and OOS window reuse fail; 1.15 same pack as the IS pack; 1.16 null pack_accept_partial fails; 3.10 counts every same-kind strategy that ever entered paper; new information-only 3.11. Strategies registered under v1 keep their own v1 copy (thresholds are not retroactive). 2.1 (blackswan fix program, 3-survivorship-pit P0-1 and 2-overfitting P1-7): new 1.18 research-universe point-in-time-ness (data lock universe.selection / universe.survivorship; a universe that does not exclude survivors caps the G1 grade at C), new 1.19 undeclared numeric literals (provenance.fixed_literals), 1.9 also checks the relative width of every robust interval itself (>= 0.2); strategies registered under v2 or v1 keep their own copy (1.18 / 1.19 are optional items).
note: Thresholds are decimal strings; a ratio threshold is {"num": n, "den": d} and compares exactly (no rounding). Canonical home: docs/contracts/validation/protocol.json (exported to VT with the research contract, pinned). Every item id is implemented in crates/strategy-registry/src/verdict.rs; an unknown or missing id makes the protocol invalid (fail closed). VT's research-side precheck (agent/alphakeel_research/precheck.py) reads the same file from the exported contract and evaluates only the items marked research_side.
